name: Diadora
verdict: Italian sportswear maker in the Geox group, controlled by the Polegato family's LIR S.r.l. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Viking's kit maker since 2011 (club partner page; Wikipedia: 'From 2011, Diadora is the technical sponsor'). Affiliated company of the Geox group per Geox's H1-2026 report; LIR S.r.l. (Mario Moretti Polegato 85% / Enrico Moretti Polegato 15%) holds 71.16% of Geox. Norwegian distribution via Ultimate Nordic AS (ex-Wenaas Nordic), a Dalema Gruppen subsidiary whose own ownership is not stated. Private family ownership with no record findings found.
